faq.question: What is a multifunction printer?
faq.answer: A device that can print, copy, scan, and fax.

faq.question: Laser or inkjet — which is better?
faq.answer: Laser printers are recommended for fast, cost-effective, high-volume printing. Inkjet printers are recommended for high-quality color prints.

faq.question: Can I get an exact price over WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on configuration and volume, so exact quotes come from the sales team rather than the bot.

faq.question: Do you only sell printers?
faq.answer: No — Trojan Technologies also sells computers and IT equipment (HP, Dell, Lenovo), software licenses, and offers IT support, network infrastructure, surveillance/access control, IP telephony, cloud solutions, and equipment rentals.
